name: Kendall Packaging Corporation
old_description: Premium graphics and product protection through industry-leading films and equipment
about:
Kendall Packaging Corporation operates from Jefferson, Wisconsin, as a privately held manufacturer of flexible packaging. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly.

The company produces flexible packaging structures including cold-seal films, eco-friendly films, and high-barrier laminations for moisture, oxygen, and light protection. Its two mirror-operation facilities run identical equipment and raw materials, enabling redundancy and consistent quality. Processes include high-speed printing, solventless adhesive lamination, and recycling programs across production lines. Real-time monitoring covers raw material receiving through final shipment.

Kendall serves food producers, brand owners, and retailers, with its FSSC 22000 certification (GFSI recognized) qualifying it for major retail supply chains. Customers range from small food manufacturers undergoing first co-packer audits to established brands managing multi-site supplier risk. Applications include heat-sensitive products and shelf-life-critical packaging.

The company emphasizes a continuous-improvement culture where every employee is trained to flag issues early, paired with third-party verified food safety systems. Its differentiators include dual-certified facilities, solventless adhesive technology to reduce energy and solvent use, and a customer-focused model offering agile solutions and dedicated support teams.
